name: Site Studio Views Element
description: Adds a Site Studio (Cohesion) custom element that lets an author pick a View block display from a dropdown and render it inside a Site Studio component or template.
provides_plugin_types: site_studio_views_element (Plugin/CustomElement/ViewsElement — a cohesion_elements CustomElement plugin, not a new plugin type)
project_description:
The Acquia Site Studio Views Element module creates a new Element for Site Studio that lets admins and authors embed a View into a component without having to add blocks to the hidden region of the theme first. If you build dynamic components in Site Studio that drop Views into pages, this module might be for you. If you have ever looked at your components or templates and saw a Block element say 'Undefined' block that used to point at a block instance of a View, this is definitely for you.

This avoids the need for remembering to add a block instance for every block display of a View to output in a Site Studio component, and remembering to 'add' those blocks in the Block Layout in Drupal when deploying to different environments. It makes it easier for authors who may have some Views knowledge to not have to deal with the added tasks of block management, and avoids performance penalties of having too many blocks in the hidden region.

The list of options for the element are all View displays that are the block plugin only. This avoids rendering other displays like feeds, pages or other types of View displays.

How to use: build a new component, add the 'Drupal View' element to the canvas, select the View block display you wish to display, and save. The View will then be injected wherever the component is used. This module pairs well with Views Minimum Condition.
